Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer prematurely concluded that Zillow could not support the required Canadian sold-home search and pivoted to alternative sites (SoldWell/CREA), violating the “according to Zillow” constraint. This assumption was not fully verified (e.g., no attempt to use zillow.ca or exhaust Zillow-specific options) and led to repeated, unproductive actions on non-Zillow sources, ultimately causing failure to deliver the requested answer.
